mark.name: mark
mark.description: The coin of the Hollow Counties, a thin copper disc stamped with a wheatsheaf on one side and whichever county minted it on the other, and every town swears the other towns' marks are light.

Throwing Knives.name: Throwing Knives
Throwing Knives.description: A belt of six balanced throwing knives, plain steel with the handles wrapped in red cord, sharp enough to split a playing card and dull enough on the spine to catch.

Patched Ring Coat.name: Patched Ring Coat
Patched Ring Coat.description: A heavy performer's coat in faded red with brass buttons, patched at both elbows and lined with old canvas from a tent that blew down, warm in the wind and thick enough to turn a cheap blade.

Bottle of Liniment.name: Bottle of Liniment
Bottle of Liniment.description: A brown bottle of horse liniment the cook swears works on people too, stinging, eye-watering stuff that takes the ache out of a bruise and the skin off a cut.
